description.value: Reynolds Resort is a lakeside retreat on Canim Lake in BC's Cariboo region, offering seven cabins with kitchenettes, lake-view sundecks, and private fire pits, as well as full-service RV sites with 30-amp electrical, water, and sewer hookups. The resort sits outside cell coverage range, surrounded by mountains and wildlife, with on-site access to fishing, kayaking, paddle boarding, and a marina. It serves as a scenic basecamp for exploring nearby Canim and Mahood Falls and extensive ATV trails.

address.value: 3789 Canim-Hendrix Lake Road, Canim Lake, V0K 1J0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Reynolds Resort is an active, operating lakeside resort on Canim Lake booking for its 2026 season (opening May 15th), with cabins and full-service RV sites. No bicycle-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site — secure bike storage, laundry, tools, and e-bike charging are all absent from the content. Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed both for RV sites ('some can enjoy wifi from your very own site') and for all guests via the boil-water/check-in instructions referencing the resort's Wi-Fi network for phone calls.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Reynolds Resort is a real, operating lakeside resort actively booking for the 2026 season. It offers accommodation useful to touring cyclists passing through the Canim Lake area.
